vndbSahAllocationPolicy: Current baseline-bound 4096-byte allocation units; exact complete file-size equality remains required across every observation.
control: A and C use the same immutable baseline package in independent fresh browser profiles.
timingPlan: Three warmups followed by twelve balanced ABC blocks. The second independent hosted job reverses each block. No retries or appended observations.
timingBoundary: Unchanged file-input change through post-UI import completion. No product or timing-harness overlay. Source CRC admission, byte-exact witnesses, completion and rejection remain at their original boundaries.
diagnostics: Before timing, actual compressed-source replay compares all three complete pinned corpora, with independent zlib CRC/size checks, strict native output parity, unchanged CRC admission/reuse, and thirty corruption/boundary rejections. Exhaustive media and four separate process-memory observations follow timing. Separate baseline/candidate browser traces follow all observations.
memoryPolicy: Existing complete-process-tree observer and fixed coverage rules, median PSS/private growth at most 5%, each individual pair at most 10%. Both independent host results remain separate.
statistics: Twelve within-block B/A, B/C and unchanged C/A comparisons per host. Descriptive paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261127. No control subtraction or pooling across hosts/corpora.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Review requires a repeatable complete-import benefit compared with both unchanged controls on both hosts, assessed against control variation, plus all correctness and memory gates. An inconclusive result is not a speed claim; all raw observations and failures remain available.
hypothesis: Consume the final complete eight-byte and four-byte words in CRC row gaps with the existing IEEE slicing tables, retaining scalar handling for the final zero to three bytes and all original span bounds.
selection: Only native function5 crc32_update_gap changes; every other function body and non-code section matches baseline. Actual compressed replay proves this function is inactive for JMdict and Jitendex under unchanged default admission. Timing is therefore prospectively limited to VNDB; all three corpora retain complete compressed parity. No JMdict/Jitendex speed claim is made.
